facts.activity_file: proving overpressure protection is in service

control_failures.control_label: controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: unplanned release of pressure energy at PSV-7101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems on PSV-7101 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically proving overpressure protection is in service. PSV-7101 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during routine operation while the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 15 December 2013 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-7101 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during routine operation; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
